data.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OLD BOXER / M02 one complete FRONT design view, portrait 2:3, warm white background. Image 1 = current Old Boxer master, SOLE identity and drawing-style authority. Image 2 = earlier original same machine, used only to understand shoulder/torso segmentation. Use the current master palette and detailing, NOT the original scene/punch camera. Do not redesign this robot.
Draw exactly ONE mature heavy boxing mecha standing UPRIGHT, true FRONT, no 3/4, no perspective lunge or punching. Same character as Image1. Compact but naturally tall ivory helmet, short red raised rectangular forehead block, recessed dark eye surround with two amber eyes, restrained ivory/brown cheeks and squared mechanical jaw. No horns, crown, animal ears or human teeth. Short visible dark neck beneath broad round shoulders.
PROPORTIONS: recover the source's full adult body when standing: about 7 to 7.5 normal helmet/skull heights excluding tiny crest. Hip-axis to sole about 55 percent of skull-top-to-floor. Thick torso, strong thighs, substantial long ivory/brown shins and wide red-toed blunt boots; not a chibi dwarf, not tiny legs under huge fists, not an athletic thin 9-head King. Do not squash helmet or widen it to make it 'small'. Glove mass strong but measured equally left/right: master front punching hand was enlarged by camera perspective and is NOT a physical one-big-fist asymmetry.
Armor identity: dominant warm IVORY/CREAM, earth TAN/BROWN barrel shoulder drums/structural panels, deep RED glove knuckles/short crest/toe accents, charcoal joints. Rounded brown shoulder drums with ivory rings and restrained red inserts, ivory upper arms, dark circular elbow and wrist articulation. Chest is paired large angular ivory pectoral plates with small red rectangular insets and lower dark/red vent slots, center tan vertical block with red low insert. Segmented ivory abdominal plates, dark articulated waist, short ivory/tan pelvis skirt. Keep only restrained seams/rubbed edges and existing replacement panels, no random rust/grime.
Preserve the APPROVED DIRECTION's repaired left/right ARMOR ASYMMETRY, distinguish it from perspective: anatomical RIGHT (viewer LEFT) front thigh panel is mostly TAN and RIGHT kneecap is deep RED. Anatomical LEFT (viewer RIGHT) thigh has the large IVORY replacement face and LEFT kneecap has the IVORY front cover with red lower inset. Same physical leg lengths/widths; this is panel/color asymmetry, not different anatomy.
Pose for turnarounds: feet only moderately apart, both soles flat, knees almost straight, shoulders level, torso untwisted. Arms relaxed slightly away from waist, elbows only slightly bent; BOTH fists closed and held low at upper-thigh height clear of pelvis. Each glove has large ivory protective back/shell and thick deep-red segmented knuckle armor; equal physical size, coherent thumbs, readable brown/charcoal wrist cuffs. Do not raise fists into chest or extend a punch toward camera.
Clean mature KINETIC CEL mechanical illustration like current Image1, crisp confident contours, broad matte paint planes and hard two-tone shadows, warm restrained highlights. No scene, halo, gradients, floor shadow, labels, numbers, letters, emblem or text. All helmet, both shoulders, glove tips and entire feet within generous margins. No new backpack weapons, wings, drill, shield, jets, fuel tanks or added attachments. Exactly one front figure.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete OLD BOXER LEFT SIDE PROFILE, facing SCREEN LEFT, portrait 2:3. Input Image 1 = current upright FRONT reference, sole authority for dimensions, colors, anatomy, panel layout and relaxed fists-low pose. Image 2 = current master, reference for armor connection and helmet identity ONLY; do NOT use its punching pose or perspective enlargement.
Preserve image1's exact upright adult body and physical lengths: SAME helmet size/height, shoulder and elbow level, hip axis, thigh length, knee height, long heavy shins, ankle level and soles. Do not compress the head or make body short/stocky. Current front body is the proportion authority, not the older crouching/punching pose. Keep both gloves the same actual dimensions, broad tan shoulder drums with ivory ring and small red inset, ivory upper arms, tan forearm cuffs, charcoal elbow/wrist joints, segmented ivory abdomen, tan pelvis and short ivory skirt plates. Palette exclusively warm ivory/cream, matte tan/earth-brown, deep red accents and charcoal; only amber eyes at front. Mature retired boxing mecha, dignified clean paint with limited repaired panel seams and a few rubbed edges. No crown, horns, wings, weapons, shield, drill, fuel tanks, giant backpack or thrusters. Clean KINETIC CEL mechanical illustration with crisp contours and broad two-tone shadows, same finish as image1. Plain warm white background. No text, numbers, arrows, logos, captions, multiple figures or action. Whole helmet through soles in frame with generous margins.
Rotate the SAME robot ninety degrees around vertical axis into LEFT SIDE; no 3/4 chest display, no camera tilt. Feet still flat in same upright pose, pointing LEFT with heels RIGHT, no crouch. Near anatomical LEFT arm/leg, far right arm/leg naturally overlap at same heights.
Head profile retains short rectangular red forehead block, ivory/tan helmet dome, small dark temple/ear structure, heavy squared ivory/brown cheek-jaw; only a sliver amber eye at FRONT left. No visor/face on back of helmet, no oversized ear antenna.
Chest projects LEFT; paired ivory pectoral plates and red slots stay on front, mostly edge-on from profile. Do not put chest vents on side. Thick tan shoulder drum seen as broad outer cap with ivory rim and red inset; same upper/lower-arm lengths. Fist held low at upper-thigh level like FRONT, elbow slightly bent, NOT raised guard. Glove shows thick IVORY back shell at REAR/right, deep RED segmented knuckle face at FRONT/left with correct thumb and wrist cuff attachment. It is one closed fist, no extra glove pasted on.
LEFT leg is the repaired leg: big IVORY replacement front/outer thigh face, IVORY kneecap with red lower inset, tan/ivory shin armor and dark circular knee/ankle pivots. Far RIGHT leg has tan thigh and red kneecap; only show naturally visible far edges, don't mirror left armor onto it. Long heavy shins retain length. Wide flat boxing boot points LEFT: red TOE at LEFT, coherent tan/ivory middle, dark ankle and short red heel protector RIGHT.
Rear torso is a compact service backplate/collar only, not a bulky jet pack. Same silhouette and physical pose as front, side projection not an unrelated redesign.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete OLD BOXER TRUE REAR view, portrait 2:3. Input Image1 is calibrated upright FRONT, sole body proportion/armor/pose authority. Input Image2 current master for identity/connection only, not punching pose. Turn SAME robot exactly 180 degrees; no 3/4, no face visible.
Preserve image1's exact upright adult body and physical lengths: SAME helmet size/height, shoulder and elbow level, hip axis, thigh length, knee height, long heavy shins, ankle level and soles. Do not compress the head or make body short/stocky. Current front body is the proportion authority, not the older crouching/punching pose. Keep both gloves the same actual dimensions, broad tan shoulder drums with ivory ring and small red inset, ivory upper arms, tan forearm cuffs, charcoal elbow/wrist joints, segmented ivory abdomen, tan pelvis and short ivory skirt plates. Palette exclusively warm ivory/cream, matte tan/earth-brown, deep red accents and charcoal; only amber eyes at front. Mature retired boxing mecha, dignified clean paint with limited repaired panel seams and a few rubbed edges. No crown, horns, wings, weapons, shield, drill, fuel tanks, giant backpack or thrusters. Clean KINETIC CEL mechanical illustration with crisp contours and broad two-tone shadows, same finish as image1. Plain warm white background. No text, numbers, arrows, logos, captions, multiple figures or action. Whole helmet through soles in frame with generous margins.
Back helmet is IVORY/TAN faceted shell with short RED central crest continuing over top as narrow red edge, charcoal nape and short neck. No eyes, brow mask or mouth on rear. Retain front helmet's tall normal volume.
Back torso: interpret source upper shoulder/neck collar as a modest IVORY upper back guard with red inset edging. Below it a compact TAN/BROWN central armored maintenance hatch with one small recessed dark rectangular cooling grille and coherent segment seams; ivory side structural plates. NO paired frontal ivory breastplates/red chest slots copied onto rear; no new jet engines, huge pipes or added weapons. Dark articulated lower back and source waist retain same heights.
ARMS: matching tan round shoulder drum backs/ivory rings/red small inserts. Ivory upper-arm rear panels, charcoal elbows, tan wrist cuffs; both gloves are LOW beside upper thighs as front. In REAR show broad IVORY armored glove BACKS and coherent wrists. Deep red knuckle faces point toward robot FRONT and are mostly hidden, only red wrap/edge details naturally visible. Do not paint full front red finger knuckles on glove backs. Same closed fist shapes, not open hands.
Preserve physical side assignment of repaired armor: anatomical RIGHT now viewer RIGHT has tan thigh and red kneecap on its FRONT (hidden from rear); anatomical LEFT now viewer LEFT has ivory replacement front/outer thigh, with only its wrapping ivory side edge seen from rear. Rear knee joints are dark hinges, NOT front kneecaps. Both leg lengths equal. Rear calves are coherent tan/ivory shell backs and dark ankle/heel pivots, use existing panel wrapping without duplicating front shin panels. Broad boxing boots show tan/ivory rear heel structure and short deep-red heel protectors; front red TOE caps do NOT face rear camera. Both flat soles share floor line.
Keep same heavy mature proportions and long-legged support as FRONT; no shrug, crouch, narrow weak legs or childlike head. Exactly one back figure.

data.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the OLD BOXER SIDE draft to correct; Image 2 current FRONT confirms EXACT armor, body proportions, glove size, and pose. Keep all body lengths, shoulder/hip/knee/ankle height, helmet size, palette and SOURCE design from Image1/2. Do not redesign.
Change ONLY the viewing angle of Image1 from three-quarter-front into a TRUE LEFT ORTHOGRAPHIC PROFILE facing SCREEN LEFT. This must look like a model sheet SIDE view, with near LEFT arm and LEFT leg concealing most of far RIGHT arm/leg. The current two feet visibly stagger sideways and broad glove knuckle face toward viewer are incorrect for the target pure profile.
Camera is exactly at LEFT side, optical axis horizontal perpendicular to the sagittal plane; no perspective, no seeing both the front and side of torso. Near and far hip, knee, ankle centers project onto same heights and nearly same x positions. Both feet have same forward toe x position, fully overlap in profile except tiny natural far-edge glimpses; do not stagger the far foot forward/left. Show one clear weight-bearing leg silhouette, far leg optional as a narrow rim only. Do not delete actual leg, just occlude it.
Near LEFT thigh has IVORY replacement front/outer armor, near LEFT knee IVORY kneecap with red lower band, near left shin tan front/ivory side shape with dark circular outer pivots. Far RIGHT red kneecap can show only a narrow red edge behind near knee, not a second broad leg. Profile boot points LEFT and shows correct deep-red toe at LEFT and small rear heel protector RIGHT, unchanged source geometry.
Near fist remains LOW, same elbow bend as front. Show its left profile thickness: red knuckle plane faces FORWARD LEFT and appears narrow/edge-on, ivory shell on upper/back/right; brown cuff connected to dark wrist. Do not display full red frontal finger grid toward viewer or an extra far glove sticking in front of torso.
Face is exact left PROFILE with one amber eye, squared cheek/jaw, short red forehead block; no second eye, no V horn. Chest pectoral armor projects LEFT as an edge/contour, not a broad frontal display. Round tan shoulder cap remains a side circle with ivory ring/red inset. Compact brown/ivory upper service-backplate to RIGHT, not new jets.
All armor panel relationships and adult upright HEIGHT intact. Keep light warm-white background and generous frame, no text, no guides, no extra views or inset. One complete TRUE LEFT PROFILE.
